headline: The agents got more autonomous and more careful, and their plugin systems got stricter.

themes.title: Autonomy, with a guard in front
themes.facts: agy extended Auto mode, where a review agent checks risky commands, to subagents ([1.4.3](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.3)) and Windows ([1.4.4](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.4)); Claude Code added `/auto-mode-setup` ([2.1.304](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.304)).
themes.so_what: "approve every command" is ending; how good the safety check is becomes the real difference.

themes.title: Plugins are checked before they load
themes.facts: `agy plugin validate` now uses the loader's own rules, with `--strict` and `--json` for CI ([1.4.0](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.0)), and it warns about Claude Code-style hook keys ([1.4.3](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.3)).
themes.so_what: if you write plugins for more than one agent, test them in each one's validator.

themes.title: Long sessions got cheaper
themes.facts: Claude Code made idle compaction a `/config` switch ([2.1.302](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.302)); agy cut CPU and memory use while streaming ([1.4.4](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.4)) and roughly halved idle CPU use ([1.4.5](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.5)).
themes.so_what: leaving an agent session open all day is becoming normal.

watch_next: OpenCode 2 is opt-in for now; the day a v2 release becomes "Latest" will be big news. Codex has shipped about 10 alphas since its last stable.
